scenario_data.body: It has been months since Mitsuka left to live overseas...
She sends me e-mails about how she is getting on daily.

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "Thank you for your last e-mail. It made me happy to read it."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I know you were wondering how was managing with the French Language..."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "But my father has taught me a lot so I'm able to speak it quite well now!"

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "We learned how to make Ratatouille in class yesterday. It's like a French hot pot."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I've attached a photo to this e-mail. I can't wait for you to try it."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I'm going to do all I can to become a great chef and then return to Japan."
I am grinning from ear to ear reading her words.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Ahaha... It sounds like she is giving it her all...!)
It does make me sad to know that I can't see her in person.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Yeah! I was hoping you would run an errand for me."
She passes me an extremely long piece of memo paper.
And on it is written a tremendous about of groceries.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "And I'm to do this all by myself?"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "You're the only one who's free right now!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I wonder what everyone else is up to...)
I strain my ears and hear a clamor down in the living room.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "What is everyone doing in the living room?"
Grinning, she gives me a push to get going.
She pushes me all the way outside.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "J-just make sure you get everything on that list, alright!?"
For some reason I am being turfed out of Famille.
Still in a daze, I look down at the shopping list she gave me once more.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "A-are they throwing a party today or something?"
I somehow manage to buy all the groceries listed on the shopping list.
I am carrying an inexplicably heavy load.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (None of it can be found at our regular supermarket...!!)
Because of this I had to go around to a lot of different shops, which is why it took so long.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "A-anyway... This is way too heavy. I can't wait to get back inside...!"
"I have finally made it back to Famille."
The familiar voice resounds in my head.
Mitsuka is supposed to be in France...

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "The French cooking school I go to has a short summer break..."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "So I've come back to Japan for the holidays."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Eh...? But you never told me that!"
The other residents of Famille come out from the living room

scenario_data.speaker: Sayaka
scenario_data.body: "Hehe... We kept it a secret from you so it would be a surprise."
I stand in silence for a moment, to surprised to speak.
Happiness wells up inside of me.
The others tell me the reason they sent me out shopping.
Apparently the groceries are all for Mitsuka.

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I want to treat you all to something I learned to make in France...!"
That's why there were so many things we don't usually buy on that list.

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "Just wait a little. I'll make it right away."
A range of impressive French dishes are arranged on the Famille dining table.
We all dive into the appetizing French meal.

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "It really is! It's like something from a 5 star restaurant!"

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I've got a long way to go before I get to that level..."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "Ah, William. The one you are eating is ratatouille."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I sent you an e-mail about it."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Ahaha! That's not how it's pronounced, William!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "You've improved your cooking a lot in just a few months."

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "I agree. I think you'll be a professional cook in no time."
And it makes me happy to see it.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (She's striving to make her dreams a reality. I can tell!!)
Mitsuka and I are alone together.
We sit together on a bench on the deck.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "That was really good! Your French cooking is the best!"
She gives me a small, but happy smile.

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "It's been so long since we talked face to face."
Up until now it's been phone calls and e-mail.
All the love I have held on to while we were apart stirs within me.
I wrap an arm around her and pull her close.
She looks surprised for a moment but soon becomes bashful.

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I... just wanted to say your name."
The love and warmth I feel beside me makes me feel like she never left.
We stare up at the stars together.
I take a breath before asking her something that has been on my mind.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I've been meaning to ask... How long are you here for?"

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "Actually, I have to go back tomorrow..."
It was too soon. We've only just seen one another again...

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I'm sorry. The summer holidays over there are very short."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "O-oh...I guess there's nothing for it then..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I guess we won't be able to see each other for a while again once she goes back to France...)

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I actually need to talk to you about something important."
Seeing the seriousness in her features, I sit up straight and attentive.

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I've managed to pull pretty good grades... And I've been selected for special honors."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "So the school is going to give me my chef's certificate..."
I had expected bad news, but it wasn't at all...

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "It usually takes 5 or 6 years to graduate from the cooking college..."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "But special honors students graduate in 2 and then go on to gain experience in a restaurant."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "Once I graduate I will be assigned to a chef here in Japan."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I'll be able to come back to Japan in two years."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "I'll come back to be with you..."
I automatically hug Mitsuka with all my might.
She was surprised at first, but she soon wraps her arms around me.
We embrace one another, expressing our shared happiness.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I never thought you would be able to come back so soon!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Thank you Mitsuka! I'm so happy right now!"

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "It's me who should be thanking you."

scenario_data.speaker: Mitsuka
scenario_data.body: "You're the reason I have been able to work so hard."
I couldn't smile any more, I feel that elated.
And all the love I feel rises to the surface.
We stare into each other's eyes.
And I draw in closer to her.
With a lingering sweetness, we part.
I look down at Mitsuka as I hold her in my arms.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "It might be a bit too soon to say it, but..."
I bring the words I've been wanting to say to the tip of my tongue.
